scripts.prebuild: npm run seed:media && npm run build:media && npm run build:social
scripts.postbuild: npm run gen:csp && npm run lint:links
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run lint:plates && npm run build && npm run lint:semantics && npm run test:colour
scripts.build:cf: npm run build && npm run lint:semantics && npm run test:colour

pinnedDependencyNotes.sharp: Pinned EXACTLY, not ranged. sharp has silently broken colour handling at least twice (libvips #2862, #4008) and it is the only thing standing between the artwork and an sRGB conversion nobody notices on a developer monitor. Upgrading is a deliberate act, gated on `npm run test:colour` passing. 0.35.3 is also the floor for libvips CVE-2026-33327 / 33328 / 35590 / 35591.
